'''Bamasians''' were a group, most notable in their appreciation of spicy foods. One of their main dessert dishes, a [[baked bread ring]], contained a protein-circuit onetime [[Holocaster/Legends|holocaster]] unit, which, when the pastry was broken, presented sage Bamasian wisdom.
